hazards.location_in_image: Corners of the T-junction where the crosswalk is located.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no dedicated, separated walkway for pedestrians, forcing them to walk in the street or on private driveways.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire street frontage in the foreground and midground.

hazards.name: Multiple Driveway Conflicts
hazards.description: The entire block consists of driveways and parking pads, creating frequent points where vehicles cross the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: The paved areas directly in front of the row houses.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked perpendicular to the houses block sightlines between drivers on the road and pedestrians emerging from the residential area.
hazards.location_in_image: White car and other vehicles parked in front of houses

hazards.name: Wide unmarked roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide street can encourage higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable positioning.
hazards.location_in_image: Center roadway

hazards.name: Sightline obstructions
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Curbsides on both left and right

hazards.name: Frequent vehicle conflict points
hazards.description: The continuous line of driveways and parking aprons means vehicles frequently cross the pedestrian path, often while reversing.
hazards.location_in_image: The paved aprons directly in front of each residential unit.

hazards.name: Narrow and Obstructed Sidewalks
hazards.description: The sidewalks are very narrow and cluttered with trash bins and stairs, potentially forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the street in the foreground and midground

hazards.name: Frequent Driveway Conflicts
hazards.description: Multiple curb cuts for residential parking create frequent points where vehicles cross the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the sidewalk on the right side

hazards.name: Absence of sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians are forced to walk in the roadway shared with vehicles due to the lack of a dedicated walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the street

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The lack of a dedicated walkway forces pedestrians to share the roadway with moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire length of the block between the curb and the houses

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street obscures pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway

hazards.name: Unmarked wide roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide residential street can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable lane positioning.
hazards.location_in_image: Center roadway

hazards.name: Sightline obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street obscures pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Both curbsides throughout the block

hazards.name: Absence of dedicated walkway
hazards.description: There is no continuous, protected sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to share space with vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire frontage between houses and roadway

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: The total absence of a dedicated pedestrian walkway forces pedestrians to share the travel lane with motor vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire length of the street frontage

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or curb ramps visible, forcing pedestrians to cross the wide roadway without designated protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the visible length of the street.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the minor street

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A fire hydrant is positioned within the narrow sidewalk path, creating a pinch point for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground on the sidewalk

hazards.name: Narrow Sidewalks
hazards.description: The walkways are extremely narrow, making it difficult for pedestrians to pass one another or for those using mobility devices to navigate safely.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the street in front of the row houses

hazards.name: Lack of Designated Crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian infrastructure to facilitate safe crossing of this wide roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire visible length of the street

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections or mid-block to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce crossing distances.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming to ensure low vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while improving the streetscape.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, raised sidewalk with a curb to provide physical separation between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install vertical traffic calming measures to ensure low vehicle speeds in this residential environment where pedestrians are present.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Intersections
interventions.description: Remove parking near corners (beyond the visible frame) to improve sightlines for pedestrians entering the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing parallel line markings to a continental or ladder pattern to increase visibility for motorists.

interventions.title: Daylighting with Flex Posts
interventions.description: Implement parking setbacks using paint and flexible bollards to ensure clear sightlines at the intersection corners.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during night hours.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or other traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds on this residential street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crossings with high-visibility patterns to designate safe places for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: Install Continuous Sidewalk
interventions.description: Construct a raised, ADA-compliant sidewalk to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians separated from vehicle parking.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lights to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Narrowing
interventions.description: Add painted lane markings to define travel lanes and narrow the perceived width of the road to slow traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or a planting strip to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the narrow sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Implement a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a visual and physical buffer between the roadway and residential frontages.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Add a vegetated buffer between the roadway and the new sidewalk to improve safety and comfort.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical buffer and create a dedicated zone for trash bins, keeping the sidewalk clear.

interventions.title: Continuous Protected Sidewalk
interventions.description: Construct a dedicated, curb-separated sidewalk to provide a safe, predictable path for pedestrians away from vehicle parking.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Buffer
interventions.description: Install street trees and a planting strip to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the roadway and the pedestrian zone.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or raised tables to reduce vehicle speeds on this residential street.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility marked crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a dedicated, ADA-compliant sidewalk separated from the roadway to provide a safe, predictable path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during evening hours.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Replace the faded transverse markings with high-visibility continental or ladder-style markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramp Upgrades
interventions.description: Install modern curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces (tactile paving) to improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: If a crossing is established across the major road, a refuge island would reduce exposure time and simplify the crossing task.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance and Enforcement
interventions.description: Enforce regulations to keep the sidewalk clear of trash bins and parked vehicles to provide a continuous walking path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Reconstruct the sidewalk to provide a wider, more consistent surface that is clearly separated from private property and driveways.

interventions.title: Parking Restrictions
interventions.description: Implement parking setbacks near driveways to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers.
